_comment: Source of truth for PRNM insurance trust layer. Derived verbatim from CSG-00536699-00 declarations. Config only - zero Supabase writes. Any coverage string rendered anywhere on poolrentalnearme.com must trace to a field in this file.

policy.effective_time_note: 12:01 AM standard time at business address; no insurance applies prior to time of application on first day

named_insured.name: Pool Rental Near Me
named_insured.business_description_verbatim: Offices of Residential Property Managers (excess over any property owner or sharing platform liability insurance)

limits.eroding_note: Each paid claim reduces the amount of insurance available during the annual period.

property_coverage.reason: CTF CW FREE 03 23 Freelance Limited Liability Coverage Endorsement: 'The insurance provided under SECTION I - Property does not apply to this policy.'
property_coverage.implication: No building, business personal property, business income, or equipment coverage exists. Never imply property protection for hosts, guests, or PRNM.

position_in_tower.basis: Business description on the declarations states coverage sits excess over any property owner or sharing platform liability insurance.
position_in_tower.exception: BP 14 88 07 13 makes this insurance primary and noncontributory ONLY where (a) the party is an additional insured, (b) the party is a Named Insured under their own other insurance, and (c) PRNM has agreed in a written contract that this insurance is primary and noncontributory.

available_mechanisms.name: Additional Insured - Managers or Lessors of Premises (Blanket)
available_mechanisms.trigger: Written agreement executed PRIOR TO LOSS to name them as additional insured, for premises or building leased or rented to PRNM
available_mechanisms.scope: Liability arising out of ownership, maintenance or use of that part of the premises leased to PRNM
available_mechanisms.ends: Any occurrence after PRNM ceases to be a tenant in the described premises
available_mechanisms.excludes: Structural alterations, new construction, demolition by or for the additional insured
available_mechanisms.cap: Lesser of the amount required by contract or the declared limits

available_mechanisms.name: Additional Insured - Lessor of Leased Equipment (Blanket)
available_mechanisms.trigger: Written lease or rental agreement for equipment executed prior to loss
available_mechanisms.ends: Any occurrence after the equipment lease expires

available_mechanisms.name: Additional Insured - Owners, Lessees or Contractors (construction contract)
available_mechanisms.trigger: Written contract while PRNM performs ongoing operations for that party
available_mechanisms.note: Excess over the additional insured's own insurance unless the written contract says primary and noncontributory

waiver_of_subrogation.trigger: Written contract executed prior to loss agreeing to waive rights of recovery

material_exclusions.name: Abuse or Molestation
material_exclusions.note: Excludes BI/PD/PAI arising from actual or threatened abuse or molestation of anyone in the care, custody or control of any insured, AND negligent hiring, investigation, supervision, reporting, or retention.

material_exclusions.name: Communicable Disease
material_exclusions.note: No coverage for transmission of communicable disease, including failure to prevent spread. Relevant to pool water and shared amenities.

material_exclusions.name: Fungi or Bacteria (Liability)
material_exclusions.note: Excludes injury from fungi or bacteria on or within a building or structure. Directly relevant to pool water quality claims.

material_exclusions.name: Total Pollution
material_exclusions.note: Any BI/PD that would not have occurred but for discharge or release of pollutants. Pool chemicals fall here.

material_exclusions.name: Damage to Work Performed by Subcontractors
Access or Disclosure of Confidential or Personal Information / Data-Related Liability
material_exclusions.note: No coverage for a data breach of guest or host records.

material_exclusions.name: Violation of Law Addressing Data Privacy
material_exclusions.note: CCPA/CIPA-style claims are outside this policy.

material_exclusions.name: Unmanned Aircraft
material_exclusions.note: Drone footage of listings is not covered.

material_exclusions.name: Cap on Losses from Certified Acts of Terrorism

fees.policy_fee_note: $50 standard; $25 in CA (business address is CA)

renewal.no_reminder_language: Renewal handling is Derek's call; this field is data, not a deadline.
